lessons.title: 3. Gradient Descent Step
lessons.description: Implement `gd_step(xs, ys, w, b, lr)` one step for y≈w*x+b. Return (w_new, b_new).
learning_objectives: Take one GD step for linear regression
lessons.solution_code:
def gd_step(xs, ys, w, b, lr):
    n = len(xs)
    dw = sum((w * x + b - y) * x for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) * 2 / n
    db = sum((w * x + b - y) for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) * 2 / n
    return w - lr * dw, b - lr * db

tests.name: test_gd_step
tests.unittest_code:
def test_gd_step(self):
    w, b = gd_step([1.0], [2.0], 0.0, 0.0, 0.1)
    self.assertAlmostEqual(w, 0.4)
    self.assertAlmostEqual(b, 0.4)

lessons.title: 4. Closed-Form Slope (Practice)
lessons.description: Implement `fit_slope(xs, ys)` for y=w*x (no intercept): w = sum(x*y)/sum(x*x).
lessons.solution_code:
def fit_slope(xs, ys):
    return sum(x * y for x, y in zip(xs, ys)) / sum(x * x for x in xs)

lessons.title: 5. Checkpoint: R² Score
lessons.description: Implement `r2(y_true, y_pred)`. Return 0 if total sum of squares is 0.
lessons.solution_code:
def r2(y_true, y_pred):
    mean_y = sum(y_true) / len(y_true)
    ss_tot = sum((y - mean_y) ** 2 for y in y_true)
    ss_res = sum((a - b) ** 2 for a, b in zip(y_true, y_pred))
    if ss_tot == 0:
        return 0.0
    return 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
